sampling_limits: Java execution sample shares exclude native GC/JIT and are not elapsed time shares.
Allocation sample weights estimate allocation churn, not retained heap.
No run1.jfr snapshot was captured for this project; the continuous recording covers all run windows.
Profile subwindows use command-start time inferred from existing GC wall/uptime logs; they include profiler setup/teardown around the requested 30-second sample.
CPU load means are fractions of host capacity, not CPU-seconds; do not interpret them as single-core fractions.
GC CPU event sums measure GC records, while stop-the-world pause totals come from GarbageCollection.sumOfPauses.
Java sample shares exclude native GC/JIT. Inclusive scopes overlap and do not equal wall-time attribution.
CPU/resource deltas are nearest 1-second process observations with endpoint errors shown.
Young post-GC heap occupancy is not an exact retained-object census.
GCCPUTime event sums do not cover every concurrent GC worker CPU; native GC stack samples are separate evidence.
Optimization statistics, JFR and CPU profiling were enabled. This receipt has no uninstrumented baseline, so total observer overhead cannot be quantified.
Absence of static-completion lookup after run2 does not establish that facts are nonstatic; fact-base values were not captured.
The call cleaner-chain family includes all cleanChain actions. It does not identify pure return cleanup. The bulk FULL return-cleanup helper is run1-forward only.
Guard.MemoryEffect is active only on forward call stages. Skipping backward identity/native suffixes needs a separate alias/cleaner correctness argument.
The transportProtection scope includes the underlying pure operation and its callbacks. Its inclusive share is not the cost of protection bookkeeping alone.
No per-fact values, full caller keys, emitted-new-versus-rejected post-statement counts, or full-versus-partial protection-mask counts were captured.
Millions of native offers and high current-demand rejection do not prove that the native results are duplicates or unnecessary. Saved replay before demand is the selected policy.
No heap read, debugger, profiler attachment, analyzer run, Gradle execution or runtime source change was performed for this offline investigation.

observations.limit: After run2, static completion is absent by design. Coalescing current summary notifications does not directly optimize saved-native replay and its suffix.

source_evidence.rule: MethodEdgeStore.add remains the authoritative post-statement deduplication point. Flow-backed add uses per-statement storage; other rows use identity bits or complete ConclusionGroup cells. A hot add stack is not proof that deduplication is absent.
replayPersistedSummaries reads saved normal summaries on every original offer, before current-demand admission; same-direction and opposite-direction views use the existing native adapters.
applyRecordView applies a saved leaf, then resumeCallees walks the current caller suffix. flow can emit post-statement results through core.emitAfter.
CallStage.Edges uses Guard.MemoryEffect only when core.forward. Backward identity results still run configured stage transfers.
transportProtection executes a pure operation once on protectedPart for output metadata and once on the full input whenever protection exists. intersectTaintMask restricts output mask coordinates.

If the entire fact is protected, the shadow and ordinary operation have equal ordinary geometry. A single-pass all-protected lane needs a proof that output metadata and one-time mark-request observations remain equal.

algorithmic_followup_candidates.candidate: Measure and remove repeated work in saved-native return suffixes.
algorithmic_followup_candidates.reason: B6/B8 current pubsub is negligible, while millions of saved matches still run caller stages and output storage.
algorithmic_followup_candidates.must_preserve: Replay each original offer and preserve full caller original, stage/call context, alias effects, cleaners, protection upgrades and backward source-to-Target discharge. Do not silently switch to fresh-only replay.
algorithmic_followup_candidates.needed_measurement: Per callee/full premise/actual input shape: native matches, distinct post-suffix output memberships, storage-new/storage-duplicate/protection-upgrade admissions and stage kinds. Then choose batching or proved no-effect skipping.

algorithmic_followup_candidates.candidate: Investigate a single-transfer lane for wholly protected facts.
algorithmic_followup_candidates.reason: Existing transportProtection deliberately runs the pure operation twice; a full mask makes the shadow geometry equal the full input.
algorithmic_followup_candidates.must_preserve: Use only operations proved pure under annotation erasure; transport taint protection to all resulting coordinates, preserve one-time mark requests and leave partial-mask behavior unchanged.
algorithmic_followup_candidates.needed_measurement: Full-mask, partial-mask and unprotected counts/weights at hot native/call operations. Inclusive transportProtection scope alone does not establish saved time or a factor-of-two improvement.
